settings.question: Can you add Apple CarPlay to my [make]'s factory screen?
settings.answer: In most cases, yes. We fit a CarPlay and Android Auto interface behind your original screen, so you keep the factory look and can still switch back to the standard menus. Send us your reg and a photo of your dash and we'll confirm what fits your car.

settings.question: Wired or wireless CarPlay: which should I get?
settings.answer: Wireless CarPlay connects a few seconds after you start the car, so your phone can stay in your pocket or bag. Wired connects when you plug in with a USB cable. We fit both, and we'll tell you which options suit your [make] when we quote.

settings.question: Will I keep my steering wheel controls and reverse camera?
settings.answer: Wherever possible, yes. We choose parts that work with your [make]'s original controls, microphone and reverse camera. If anything can't be kept, we'll tell you before you book, not after.

settings.question: How long does the fitting take?
settings.answer: Most CarPlay and Android Auto installs take one to two hours at our Dublin 12 workshop. Japanese-to-European conversions take around two hours. We'll confirm the time when you book.

settings.question: Do I need to pay a deposit?
settings.answer: Yes. A €50 deposit secures your fitting slot. We agree the full fitted price with you before you book, so there are no surprises on the day.
